name: Compatibility-Read Safe Rollout (Control S2)
description: Safe rollout where application uses a compatibility read abstraction during rollout until completed reconciliation and verification.

phases.name: Expand Schema
phases.description: Add lookup table, status_id column, and compatibility view

phases.name: Compatibility Phase
phases.description: Active sync trigger and compatibility read path

phases.name: Cutover Phase
phases.description: New app queries via compatibility read layer

expand_schema.description: DDL: Create order_statuses, add status_id, and install compatibility view and sync triggers
expand_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_statuses (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(32) UNIQUE NOT NULL); INSERT INTO order_statuses (id, name) VALUES (1, 'pending'), (2, 'paid'), (3, 'shipped'), (4, 'refunded') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_id INT REFERENCES order_statuses(id); CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_orders_compat AS SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_amount, COALESCE(os.name, o.status) AS resolved_status, o.status_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_statuses os ON o.status_id = os.id;

backfill_orders.sql: UPDATE orders o SET status_id = s.id FROM order_statuses s WHERE o.status = s.name AND o.status_id IS NULL;

legacy_order_update_shipped.sql: UPDATE orders SET status = 'shipped', status_id = 3 WHERE id = 42;

new_app_read_compat.description: New Application: Read through compatibility view
new_app_read_compat.sql: SELECT id, resolved_status FROM v_orders_compat WHERE id = 42;

invariants.name: Compatibility View Consistency Invariant
invariants.description: Ensures that compatibility view resolved_status matches status when status_id is set.
invariants.sql: SELECT o.id, o.status, o.status_id, v.resolved_status FROM orders o JOIN v_orders_compat v ON o.id = v.id WHERE o.status_id IS NOT NULL AND o.status != v.resolved_status;
